class.name: OcgBrepmeshDiscretalgofactory
class.brief_description: Abstract factory for creating meshing algorithms. This class provides a registry-based factory pattern that allows multiple meshing algorithms to coexist without symbol collisions. It follows the pattern established by Graphic3d_GraphicDriverFactory.
